about: Key moments for chapter 28, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Medium wide shot of a plain conference room with a table and chairs. A middle-aged man, the man from reference image 1, steps in through the door wearing a crisp shirt styled like traditional military attire but comfortable for everyday wear, with a direct, wary expression. At the table, the man from reference image 2 rises slightly to greet him, calm and measured, while three younger people sit watching, seen from behind. Soft daylight through a window, muted greens and stone greys.

Lively medium shot of a hotel room with a sofa and warm lamps. The boy from reference image 1 bursts in and leaps onto the sofa, bouncing, holding a hand device whose screen shows only soft abstract colored shapes, his face bright with excitement. The woman from reference image 2 turns from the open door behind him, smiling with surprised delight. A man sits in an armchair in the background, seen from behind. Warm evening light, muted greens and earth tones.

A severe, orderly classroom with rows of identical pale desks and cold white light. The girl from reference image 1 stands up from her desk, chin raised, confidently explaining something with one hand gesturing, a thin band around her neck. At the front of the room a stern instructor in a stiff grey uniform scowls at her with crossed arms. Other students in matching outfits turn to stare. Icy whites, pale blues and steel greys.

Quiet medium shot of a hotel room by a window overlooking green treetops. The woman from reference image 1 pours herself a cup of tea from a pot at a small table, glancing up with curiosity. The man from reference image 2 stands nearby, lowering his wrist from a watch, with a calm, satisfied half smile as he shares good news. Soft morning light, muted greens, warm stone and wood.
